answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each agent's identity in a stake-backed kernel: every new agent locks a small refundable deposit that only unlocks after sustained honest work. When one bad actor spins up thousands of fake agents, the deposits create real cost, like a gale stripping away lightweight fakes while rooted agents hold. Honest attestations then ripple outward — each verified interaction raises the agent's reputation weight, so cheap clones cannot borrow the trust earned by real contributors.
